summary: Redact credential-bearing Git key subsections in integrator diagnostics and refuse worktree-local commit identity overrides.

compatibility.detail: Deployment-only scripts. User identity keys must be in common repository config, not config.worktree; unknown keys still fail closed.

manual.detail: No released-product manual step. Deployment operators reconcile any refused worktree identity keys before retrying integration.

recovery.detail: Application data and published builds are unchanged.
